context: Ren reports a client negotiation to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business report; vocabulary (資産/顧客/交渉/金額/会計) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大事な顧客と、交渉してきました。
lines.en: I negotiated with an important client.
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 金額は、折り合ったかね?
lines.en: Did the amount come to terms?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 希望の金額で、合意できました。
lines.en: We agreed on the desired amount.
lines.style: confident young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 会計の処理は、頼んだかね?
lines.en: Did you ask for the accounting?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、会計に回しました。
lines.en: Yes, I sent it to accounting.
lines.style: reliable young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この顧客は、大きな資産になるな。
lines.en: This client will be a great asset.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 顧客との信頼も、資産ですね。
lines.en: Trust with clients is an asset too.
lines.style: thoughtful young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 良い交渉だった。引き続き頼む。
lines.en: A good negotiation. Keep it up.
lines.style: satisfied boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
